## Highlights
Showing the 12 most recent highlights from 217 user-facing changes.
### New
- Choose your default browsing engine and add, edit or remove website engine rules in Settings. Chromium is recommended, while WebKit offers native handling and FairPlay video.
### Improved
- WebKit sessions leave Chromium unloaded until you open a Chromium website or extension. Once loaded, it stays ready until you quit Crest. - The default Mac download includes Chromium and WebKit, with a separate WebKit build available. Each build keeps its own update channel. - The final experimental update moves your update preference to Development so future Crest updates continue there. - Crest for Mac is one download with both engines. Copies of the separate WebKit download update to it automatically. - Extension popups, such as a password manager's settings popout, open as a tab in your current window instead of a new window.
### Fixed
- Extensions can move, resize and restore Crest windows using their normal window controls. - Chromium pages keep rendering while you swipe between Spaces instead of turning gray. - Pressing Return in Find moves to the next match instead of skipping several ahead. - Clicking a field in the other half of a split view lets you type there on the first click. - Crest no longer quits when an extension closes its popup window, as Bitwarden does after you turn on unlock with biometrics. - Restarting to install an update, or choosing Quit from the Dock, quits Crest so the update installs instead of waiting forever.
---

## Highlights
Showing the 12 most recent highlights from 39 user-facing changes.
### New
- Middle-click a split title to close the split and all its tabs. - Choose to return saved tabs to their saved URL with one favicon click on Mac.
### Improved
- Choose whether unloaded tabs appear dimmed in Look and Feel settings - Quick Window Space indicators now use balanced padding. - Choose whether Now Playing appears in the sidebar.
### Fixed
- Select webpage text and use controls near the top edge without moving the window - Save the displayed PDF directly from the built-in preview - Quick Windows follow your browser border size while keeping balanced spacing around their controls - Image-converter extensions can save JPEGs repeatedly and keep their image menus after restarting Crest - Return from Picture in Picture to the tab and browser window that started playback - Prevent password manager popups and login-field suggestions from repeatedly reloading webpages - Settings remain fully visible while switching between Spaces.
---
Stable releases are signed, notarized, and ready for everyday use.
